summary: Documentation audit of cchsflow v3 working tree (branch fix/v3-smoking-worksheet-sync). The 9 vignettes, _pkgdown.yml, README, NEWS.md and DESCRIPTION all still describe the v2.1.0 (2022) package: they teach removed functions (bmi_fun, Pack_years_fun with if_else2/ifelse2), reference deleted man topics, run examples against worksheet variables that no longer exist (DHHGAGE_A/B), and state 2001-2018 coverage when v3 worksheets span 2001-2023 including _m master databases. _pkgdown.yml lists 28 reference topics with no man page (pkgdown build fails) while 90 of 125 current exports are absent from the index. NEWS.md's newest entry is mislabelled 2.0.1 (the 2022-05-05 v2.1.0 release) with nothing since. DESCRIPTION lacks a VignetteBuilder field, so the vignettes have never shipped in the installed package - docs exist only on the pkgdown site. Against the Divio framework (the gap the recodeflow scoping explicitly flags at /tmp/recodeflow-pr43/index.qmd:37-38), the vignettes partially cover tutorial/how-to/reference/explanation for the v2 consumer, but v3's defining features - the 3-step derived-variable architecture, clean_variables, missing-pattern utilities, worksheet schemas, master-file support, and the 16 new worksheet columns - have zero user-facing documentation; the architecture rationale lives only in CEPs, .claude skills, and untracked docs/superpowers debris.

evidence: /Users/dmanuel/github/cchsflow/_pkgdown.yml:64-97 lists bmi_fun, adjusted_bmi_fun, bmi_fun_cat, pct_time_fun, resp_condition_fun1/2/3, binge_drinker_fun, adl_fun, adl_score_5_fun, low_drink_short_fun, low_drink_long_fun, low_drink_score_fun, low_drink_score_fun1, immigration_fun, pct_time_fun_cat
/Users/dmanuel/github/cchsflow/_pkgdown.yml:101-112 lists ALW_1...ALCDTTM whose Rd files are deleted (git status: D man/ALW_1.Rd, D man/ALCDTYP.Rd, etc.)

Cross-check script output: 28 _pkgdown.yml reference items have no man/ topic; 90 of 125 NAMESPACE exports (all calculate_*, assess_*, categorize_*, clean_variables, any_missing, get_priority_missing, check_worksheet schema loaders, cache utilities) are missing from the reference index
/Users/dmanuel/github/cchsflow/NAMESPACE:3-127 vs _pkgdown.yml:52-158
issues.why_design_issue: pkgdown errors on reference entries that have no documentation topic, so the v3 doc site cannot be rebuilt at all. The index is also organized around v2's flat 'derived variable functions' list, which cannot express v3's layered design (engine vs cleaning vs DV functions vs worksheet tooling vs metadata utilities) - a symptom of the docs never being treated as part of the architecture.
issues.candidate_fix: Regenerate the reference section from NAMESPACE, grouped by v3 layers (recoding engine; metadata-driven cleaning; derived-variable functions by subject; worksheet validation; missing-pattern utilities; datasets). Mark internal helpers @keywords internal instead of indexing them. Add pkgdown::check_pkgdown() to CI so the index can never drift from exports again.

issues.candidate_fix: Update Example 4 to the year-based era names actually in variables.csv (e.g. DHHGAGE_pre2015-style names or DHHGAGE_cont), fix the typos and ?calculate_bmi pointer, and turn on vignette building in CI so example regressions fail the build.

Meanwhile machine-readable schemas now exist at inst/metadata/schemas/core/*.yaml but the prose docs are maintained by hand in parallel.
issues.candidate_fix: Regenerate the column documentation from inst/metadata/schemas/core/variables.yaml and variable_details.yaml (single source of truth), add a section on _m master vs _p PUMF vs _s share databases and the era-naming convention, and fix the DHHA_SEX and recStart/recEnd errors.

issues.title: Divio gap: no documentation system for distinct user types, and v3's architecture has zero user-facing explanation
evidence: /tmp/recodeflow-pr43/index.qmd:37-38: 'The documentation not catering to different types of users (not using the divio style of documentation)' listed as a core user-feedback issue motivating the next version

Divio mapping of the 9 vignettes: tutorial = get_started.Rmd (mixed with reference material, e.g. lines 206-233 argument reference); how-to = how_to_harmonize.Rmd, how_to_add_variables.Rmd, worksheet_formatting.Rmd; reference = variables_sheet.Rmd, variable_details.Rmd; explanation = derived_variables.Rmd, tagged_na_usage.Rmd, duplicate_datasets.Rmd. Consumer and contributor content interleaved in the same articles (how_to_add_variables.Rmd serves only contributors but sits beside consumer articles with no signposting; _pkgdown.yml:26-44 navbar is a flat 8-item menu)

90 of 125 exports (the entire v3 surface: clean_variables, any_missing, get_priority_missing, get_missing_pattern_*, load_worksheet_schemas, get_variables/get_variable_details, auto_detect_database...) appear in no vignette: grep of vignettes/*.Rmd finds zero mentions of clean_variables, calculate_bmi, assess_adl, or any v3 function name

Architecture rationale exists only in non-user-facing locations: ceps/ (CEP review artifacts), /tmp/cchsflow-recovered-specs/, untracked docs/superpowers/{plans,specs}/ (git ls-files docs/ returns 0 tracked files; docs/ gitignored in commit 620ca0f3, 2025-06-03)

No migration guide exists for the v2->v3 mass renames (bmi_fun->calculate_bmi, adl_fun->assess_adl, low_drink_*->calculate_drinking_risk_*, immigration_fun->categorize_immigration) - nothing in vignettes/, README.md, or NEWS.md mentions any rename
issues.why_design_issue: This is the exact complaint the recodeflow v4 scoping commits to fixing, and the current state would block that goal: three distinct audiences (researchers consuming harmonized data; contributors authoring worksheet rows and DV functions; developers of the engine) share one undifferentiated article list, and the largest API expansion in the package's history is documented only in internal artifacts. Users who upgrade will find every function they used renamed with no guide.
issues.candidate_fix: Adopt an explicit Divio structure in _pkgdown.yml navbar (Tutorials / How-to / Reference / Explanation, with consumer vs contributor sub-sections). Promote the 3-step architecture explanation from CEP/spec material into an 'Architecture' explanation article. Add a v2->v3 migration how-to with a rename table. Decide a single home for contributor/developer docs (tracked, rendered) instead of ceps + .claude skills + untracked docs/.

evidence: /Users/dmanuel/github/cchsflow/NEWS.md:1-2: top entry '# cchsflow 2.0.1' dated 2022-05-05, but DESCRIPTION:4-5 says Version 2.1.0, Date 2022-05-05 and git tag v2.1.0 exists - the 2.1.0 release notes carry a 2.0.1 heading (duplicate of NEWS.md:53)

No NEWS entry exists after 2022-05-05; absent: 3-step DV architecture, ~70 new calculate_*/assess_*/categorize_* exports, check_worksheet/fix_worksheet, clean_variables, 2019-2023 database coverage, _m master support, function renames/removals (git status shows 20+ deleted man pages and 40+ new ones)
issues.why_design_issue: NEWS is the contract with upgrading users. A wrong version heading on the current CRAN release plus silence over four years of breaking changes means there is no changelog trail for the v2->v3 break - which the v4 effort will need to reconstruct anyway for deprecation messaging.
issues.candidate_fix: Correct the duplicated heading to '# cchsflow 2.1.0'. Draft a v3.0.0 section now (breaking renames table, new architecture, new database coverage, worksheet tooling) while the history is recoverable from CEPs and git log; keep it updated as v3 lands.
